author: ELMIRA

title: I love it so much
body: I have tried many self care apps in the past and they didn’t really work for me. This is incredibly helpful and life-changing in a way. It’s crazy how much a singular app has helped me improve my quality of life in every field (sleep, work, social life, relaxation, nourishment, exercise). I wasn’t expecting to like it at all. I thought that I was gonna use it for three days and then uninstall it like I’ve done with many other apps. But turns out it is now one of my favorite apps in my phone. I have also invited my friends and now we are all playing together and they are equally obsessed. The game is so cute and has so many cool features.
author: dollykara

title: Lovely app, developers please read
body: Hello, I have been using the app for a while and I recently got sponsored by a guardian. With the now free month I am excelling in my mental health and more motivated than ever! However I do worry about how I will be after the sponsorship ends, as there are many beneficial, useful, and excellent features that I can’t really let go of. I was wondering if, for people who won sponsorships maybe the developers could gift finch plus if they don’t have the budget for a reduced option (I’ve heard about reduced prices so I’m just throwing that in there), and these winners could go on to pay it forward by becoming a guardian when they are in a better situation! Please consider my request, and for people here for a review, please know the free version alone is better than any other self care app on the market) in my opinion.

author: rardies

title: I love this!!
body: This app has helped me so much and has got me through some tough times! There was a point in my time using this app where I was extremely fatigued and missed a few days. I felt really guilty for not logging in and decided that I would log in the next month. I thought that it was going to continue as it was before, but when I opened the app it gave me a message about how it’s ok that I missed some days and that coming back on was progress. My guilt almost immediately vanished and I was extremely happy that it was ok. I love both you and your work Niko and Steph!!
